extension.name: Configuration Manager
extension.description: CiviCRM configuration management with YAML export/import, UI, API4 automation, and system-status checks.
extension.comments: Alpha 60 hotfix on the full alpha59 codebase: fixes SQLTasks and generic API3 provider restore by filtering create/update payloads to writable create-spec fields, preserves nested provider configuration, and isolates virtual contributed-provider imports from unrelated extension YAML validation/apply.
